reason: I run the counter myself during the rush, I am not going to stop and punch PINs for coupons, and I don't sign up for new apps. If my nephew wants creators he can message them on WhatsApp like he does now.
objection: Customers won't bother showing a coupon, and my staff won't bother redeeming it in the rush, so the counting will be wrong anyway. And a ₹200-a-month payment from a beta app I've never heard of feels like a catch somewhere.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked over WhatsApp with no login, and someone I know in the area showed me real extra customers it brought them.
